title: Dhurandhar 2 Box Office Day 7: Earnings Dip, Film Crosses ₹625 Cr in India, ₹1000 Cr Worldwide in One Week
text:
Mumbai, India — March 26, 2026
The box office momentum of Dhurandhar 2 continues to remain strong despite a noticeable slowdown on Day 7. The film, which has dominated cinemas since its release, has now crossed major milestones both in India and globally within its first week.
According to early estimates reported by Sacnilk, the film earned ₹47.70 crore on its seventh day (Wednesday), marking a drop compared to its earlier weekday collections.
Dhurandhar 2 Day-Wise Box Office Collection (India)
- Day 1 (Opening): ₹102.55 crore
- Previews: ₹43 crore
- Day 2: ₹80.72 crore
- Day 3: ₹113 crore
- Day 4 (Sunday): ₹114.85 crore
- Day 5 (Monday): ₹65 crore
- Day 6 (Tuesday): ₹56.60 crore
- Day 7 (Wednesday): ₹47.70 crore
➡️ Total India Collection (7 Days): ₹625.18 crore
Day 7 Performance: Slight Dip but Strong Hold
After an explosive opening weekend, Dhurandhar 2 has seen a gradual decline in weekday earnings, which is typical for big-ticket releases. Despite the dip, the film continues to maintain a strong hold at the box office, signaling sustained audience interest.
Worldwide Collection Crosses ₹1000 Crore
The film has delivered exceptional performance globally:
- Overseas Collection: ₹260+ crore
- Worldwide Total (7 Days): ₹1000+ crore
With this, Dhurandhar 2 has:
- Become one of the fastest films to cross ₹1000 crore globally
- Matched the record pace of Pushpa 2
- Emerged as the 5th Hindi film and 10th Indian film to enter the ₹1000 crore club
Box Office Analysis
Dhurandhar 2 earned ₹47.70 crore on Day 7, taking its India total to ₹625.18 crore and crossing ₹1000 crore worldwide within one week, despite a weekday slowdown.
FAQ Section
Q1. How much did Dhurandhar 2 earn on Day 7?
The film earned ₹47.70 crore on its seventh day at the Indian box office.
Q2. What is the total India collection of Dhurandhar 2?
The total India collection after 7 days stands at ₹625.18 crore.
Q3. Has Dhurandhar 2 crossed ₹1000 crore worldwide?
Yes, the film has crossed ₹1000 crore globally within its first week.
Q4. How does Dhurandhar 2 compare to Pushpa 2?
It has matched the pace of Pushpa 2 in reaching the ₹1000 crore milestone.
